latest_release.body:
# RLS Career Overhaul v2.8.1

From the drag strip to the streets, here are the highlights since v2.8.0.

## Stage up. Risk the keys.

- Open **Motorsport Events** on your phone for sanctioned drag weekends at Alder. Choose from 19 classes across four leagues, stage at the tree, qualify and run the elimination bracket, or bet on heats from the stands.
- Join **Car Meets** for No Prep Knights invites. Challenge five West Coast bosses for pink slips, defend your title or win back a lost car in a rematch.

## Tune it your way

- Use **Fuel & Ignition** to set mixture, spark and boost, then save your maps. Choose Regular, Premium or E85 at West Coast pumps, or pick up M100 and Nitro 90 at Alder. The redesigned pump lets you fill or drain each tank separately on two-tank builds.
- **Upgraded afterfire and rolling coal:** Rich mixtures or late spark can send enough unburned fuel into a hot exhaust to make flames. Diesels roll coal under load when the tune delivers more fuel than the available air can burn.

## Build it. Put it to work.

- Build for the strip with slicks, radials, front runners and wide front tires for front-wheel-drive cars. Dyno and refuel Racing Team cars, or export a build with its fuel setup from the garage computer.
- **Job Broker** routes new loads, keeps pickups visible and clears finished stops. **BeamEats** sends drivers to reachable drop-offs.

## Drift and stay in the loop

- Set a new best at **Drift Playground**, which replaces Drift Loop Remaster. Five other drift events have new score goals.
- Swipe down from the top of the phone to catch up on missed alerts in **Notification Center**. Watch rain and fog roll in gradually, and check **Weather** to see when rain is actually falling.

## Fixes and smaller changes

- **Racing and cars:** Cleaner staging, qualifying and finishes, with withdrawal after a wreck. Pink-slip prizes keep their value, upgrades, wear and gearbox mode. Tires fit and wear correctly, derby repairs restore popped tires, and certified engines can go back into the original car.
- **Jobs and garages:** Rental trucks use bays they fit, work trailers unhitch at drop-off, and loaner cuts apply once. Company locks show the missing requirement, taxis recover after crashes, storage garages with space offer buying, and auctions wait for the balance to load.
- **Menus, world and saves:** High Contrast keeps phone colours, profile search accepts typing, and OBD clears repaired faults. Map travel prefers marked parking and career weather leaves Free Roam alone. Large parts collections load, insurance saves after a sale, and failed saves report errors.

## Install

- Download **rls_career_overhaul_v2.8.1.zip** from Assets below.
- Replace your older Overhaul ZIP; keep only one version enabled.
- Back up saves before updating. If importing an older career, use **Create migrated copy** so the original stays untouched.
- Use compatible versions of any additional career map mods.

## Thanks to

- @flappelapper for the early No Prep Knights launches, and @kozdas for the value of cars won back on pink slips.
- @alphawolf1979-blip for the unreachable BeamEats stop, @ShMu-x3d for the misleading company-vehicle requirement, and @PlatinumXModz for tracing the off-road recovery shift error.
- @Leo-nerd-o for the certified-engine reinstall report and @timmysqueak-a11y for the missing Alder Dragway buy tab.
- @lcke1 for reporting the phone's High Contrast issue.
- @Xetius for the two large-collection save reports and the trailer drop-off crash report.
- @JadeFalcon-1 for reports on fitted tires, work trucks and saved tunes, and @MatVeiQaaa for the Tuning Shop reports.
- @lizard280, @oMInts15, @ThrustTM, @freefallguitar and @dogman1214 for Job Broker reports; @AJVini, @msdl923, @wriley, @DrSeedon and @beefybanana for the cargo, loaner and shift reports.
- @NeoZ83-4, @Dirtbikr98, @DavidHunter72, @D4wnTreader and @sjveijk for vehicle and repair reports; @strakamichal, @Fsxnerd, @ytsum and @Esharaonxbox for reports

detail.readme:
# RLS Career Overhaul

Build a career around the way you like to drive. Race, deliver cargo, run businesses, work shifts, buy and build cars, or take a different route through police work and off-road events.

**v2.8.1 Public Release · BeamNG.drive 0.40.5**

[Download v2.8.1](https://github.com/RLS-Modding/rls_career_overhaul/releases/latest) · [Getting started](https://github.com/RLS-Modding/rls_career_overhaul/wiki/Installation) · [Wiki](https://github.com/RLS-Modding/rls_career_overhaul/wiki) · [Report a bug](https://github.com/RLS-Modding/rls_career_overhaul/issues)

![Drag launch at the strip](ui/modules/whatsnew/2.8.1/drag-launch.jpg)

## Your career

Overhaul has its own career mode, saves and RLS West Coast map. Start a new career or import an older RLS career as a separate copy, keeping the original save.

- **Jobs and deliveries:** Find work in Job Broker, group matching jobs in My Loads, and haul parcels, materials, fluids and vehicles with suitable equipment.
- **Shifts and passengers:** Work for employers, drive taxis and buses, and take on recovery, quarry and facility work.
- **Cars and garages:** Shop dealerships, negotiate purchases, manage storage, sell through the Marketplace, and buy or list vehicles at auction.
- **Workshops and businesses:** Build and manage engines, tune vehicles, organise fleet work, and track business finances.
- **Racing and events:** Run drag, circuit, rally, drift, crawling and other events. Compatible map courses can use the shared Dakar system.
- **Police and insurance:** Take police work, deal with pursuits and fines, and choose coverage and repairs for your cars.
- **Money and progression:** Track income and spending in Wallet, review activity in Logbook History, and build skills as you play.

Available jobs, facilities and events depend on your map, equipment and career progress.

## What's new in v2.8.1

- **Motorsport Events:** sanctioned drag weekends with staging, qualifying, eliminations and spectator betting across 19 classes and four leagues.
- **No Prep Knights:** street racing for cash or pink slips, with title defenses, win-backs and the new Belasco Sewer venue.
- **Fuel & Ignition:** tune fuel maps, mixture, spark and boost. Rich or late-spark tunes now light up the exhaust with afterfire, and over-fuelled diesels roll coal under load.
- **Fuel grades:** pick Regular, Premium, E85, M100 or Nitro 90 and fill two tanks separately.
- **Builds and work:** drag tires and injection hardware, Racing Team dyno and Pit Fuel, portable builds, and smoother Job Broker routes.
- **West Coast and phone:** the new Drift Playground course, Notification Center and smoother weather and daylight.
- Plus a large round of fixes for saves, insurance, deliveries, garages and menus.

[Read the full changelog](https://github.com/RLS-Modding/rls_career_overhaul/releases/tag/v2.8.1).

![No Prep Knights street racing](ui/modules/whatsnew/2.8.1/no-prep.jpg)

## Install

1. Download **`rls_career_overhaul_v2.8.1.zip`** from the [release Assets](https://github.com/RLS-Modding/rls_career_overhaul/releases/latest).
2. In the BeamNG launcher, open **Manage User Folder → Open in Explorer**. Use the user folder for the profile you actually play.
3. Put the ZIP in its `mods` folder. Leave it zipped.
4. Remove or disable older Overhaul copies, including unpacked copies. Enable the new version in the Mod Manager and restart the game after changing versions.
5. Open **RLS Career Overhaul** from its main-menu or Career-screen entry.

Use the named release ZIP for installation. You do not need to build anything from this repository.

## Returning players

Back up your saves before updating. In the Overhaul profile screen, choose **Load** on a detected older RLS career to open its **Compatibility report**. Continue to **Choose what to keep**, review any keep/cash-out choices, then choose **Create migrated copy**. The original save stays untouched. Stock-only careers are not supported by this importer.

If your save is missing, check that you opened the same BeamNG user folder/profile where it was saved. Do not delete or overwrite the original to make it appear. See [Saves and migration](https://github.com/RLS-Modding/rls_career_overhaul/wiki/Saves-and-Migration).

The final page of the update intro lets you choose a phone shortcut. Existing custom bindings stay saved. You can also manage the shortcut through the phone’s **Controls** app; there is no default phone shortcut for a fresh setup. If you skipped setup or cannot open the phone, use **Options → Controls**, search for **Toggle Phone**, and assign a key or controller button there.

## Maps

RLS West Coast is included. Additional career maps are installed as map mods, with their career locations and data bundled in the same download. Use a map version compatible with your Overhaul release. Available jobs, facilities and events vary by map.

## Help and bug reports

Start with the [troubleshooting guide](https://github.com/RLS-Modding/rls_career_overhaul/wiki/Troubleshooting), then search [existing issues](https://github.com/RLS-Modding/rls_career_overhaul/issues) before opening another report.

Include:

- BeamNG and Overhaul versions, map versions.
- Whether the save is new or migrated.
- Steps to reproduce, what you expected and what happened.
- A screenshot or short video, and `beamng.log` from the affected session.
- Whether it also happens with only Overhaul and its required map files enabled.

Keep save backups when troubleshooting. Check logs for personal paths or other information you do not want to share.

## Contributing

Have a fix, translation or idea? See the [contribution guide](CONTRIBUTING.md) for reports, PRs and how we carry accepted changes into development and public releases. Contributors only need to open a PR here; maintainers handle the matching dev work.

For suspected security vulnerabilities, use the [private reporting policy](SECURITY.md).

## Credits

Created and maintained by **RLS Modding**, with help from contributors, testers and the community. See the [v2.8.0 credits](CREDITS.md), [contributors](https://github.com/RLS-Modding/rls_career_overhaul/graphs/contributors) and bundled `licenses` for included third-party material.

RLS Career Overhaul is a community mod and is not affiliated with BeamNG GmbH.

## Licensing

Original RLS source listed in the [license scope](licenses/RLS-AGPL-SCOPE.md) is AGPLv3-only with a BeamNG additional permission. BeamNG-derived files and included components retain their applicable licenses. See [Licensing](LICENSING.md) and [third-party notices](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md).
